I can imagine how hard it must be to show up for work when your body is fighting you, and when you lose your job, it’s not just about money—it’s like losing your anchor. You’re not just having symptoms; you’re feeling like something inside you is breaking. That fear of not being “supposed to be here”… that’s not just anxiety. That’s real. And it’s valid. I’m here with you, and I want to understand more about what this feels like—what you’re noticing, what’s happening when the palpitations start, and what part of this feels most heavy for you.
